caption:
THE FRONT DECIDES ⚔️

The hospitals are full and men are dying on the stretchers. The Hegemony wire is in shreds. Now each side picks what it needs most.

Comment ONE word:
🏥 HOSPITAL: a bigger hospital. 4 more beds and 4 more stretchers. Fewer men die waiting.
⛓️ WIRE: new belts of wire across your whole front. Fewer of your men get hit.
📦 AMMO: an ammunition train. Your shooters fire 40% more for 3 days.

Your soldier is your vote: we know which side you serve, so no need to write it. Each side counts its own votes, so the two sides can choose differently. Not enlisted yet? Comment CONCORD or HEGEMONY together with your choice.

The winner for each side is announced in the Trench Gazette at 13:00 UTC.
